messages:
morgan: Heads-up — deploying RBAC consolidation in console at 12:30 PST. We're collapsing some viewer/editor overlaps: 'viewer' will lose billing view/edit escape hatch, 'editor' scopes will be trimmed to project-level edits. Please do quick sanity checks for implicit grants, KMS perms, and audit logging. If anything blocks, I'll hold the deploy. @kevin @yana @security-oncall
kevin: Quick Q — did we remove the legacy role aliasing where api_key => admin if group mapping missing? that's where most implicit admin leaks appeared before.
morgan: Good call. I disabled role alias fallback in the feature branch. mapping snippet:
```
roles:
  - name: editor
    grants: [project.read, project.write]
  - name: viewer
    grants: [project.read]
legacy_aliases: disabled
```
kevin: Thanks. Still want to verify token introspect path returns intended scopes. I can run a few token checks before 12:30.
yana: Audit logging: ensure KMS decrypt/encrypt ops are tied to console actions. If we trim editor perms, we must still surface KMS key use in logs for investigations. Example query to find decrypts:
```
resource.type="kms_key"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"
"actor:" "console-service"
```
security-bot: automated policy scan found one binding: `binding: { role: viewer, members: [serviceAccount:old-sync@redwood-prod] }` — that SA has kms.decrypt. flagged as high. https://sec.team/flags/7182 :warning:
carla: Assigning triage: @morgan add revert playbook link, @kevin run token-introspect, @ops-oncall verify audit query works in staging. I'll take follow-up with infra to remove old-sync SA or scope its kms perms.
ops-oncall: Running audit query in staging now — ETA 7m.
morgan: If ops-oncall can't show decrypt events tied to console actions in staging within 10m, hold deploy. Otherwise proceed with canary to 5%.
kevin: token checks passed for 3 sample tokens, no implicit admin. sending logs in thread.
morgan: Thanks — continuing canary. Will open postmortem if any unexpected privilege escalations surface. :thumbsup:
